content:
jess: quick heads up — onboarding int8-ggml-v2 on the eval runner (t0-suite) shows weird metric failures. ROUGE drops ~6 pts vs FP32 and BERTScore is throwing NaNs, runner assertion fails mid-batch.

omar: can you paste the failing stack + the eval config you used?

jess: here's the failing log snippet:
```
AssertionError: MetricRunner: score is NaN for example id=42
  File "/srv/eval/runner/metrics/bertscore.py", line 128, in compute
    assert np.linalg.norm(vec) > 0
```
and the eval config:
```yaml
model: int8-ggml-v2
tokenizer: byte-level
metrics: [rouge, bertscore]
batch_size: 8
```

kai: my guess — embedding kernel under certain quant paths returns a zero vector (or full-NaN) after kv-cache reuse. saw something similar with symmetric int8 last quarter.

eva: quick repro command to try locally:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:8080/eval \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"int8-ggml-v2","inputs":["Translate this sentence to French."]}'
```
should reproduce the NaN BERTScore in the runner logs if it's the same issue.

ci-bot: build #432 failed: eval-runner-smoke — https://ci.internal/builds/432 (failing test: metrics::bertscore_smoke)

omar: can repro locally with a tiny harness, looking at tokenization differences between fp32 and quantized runtime — seems padded tokens sometimes become non-zero in embedding table after quant mapping.

jess: note: the assertion that's tripping is exactly `assert np.linalg.norm(vec) > 0` in metrics/bertscore.py. we shouldn't crash CI on this class — we need a guard but also a root cause.

kai: short-term mitigation: add small eps to the norm calc and continue, plus unit test that flags zero-norm examples. long-term: fix the kernel producing zeros.

eva: also ran rouge locally: the tokenization differs, e.g. fp32 tokens: `["Translate","this","sentence"]` vs quant runtime tokens: `["Translate","this","sentence","Ġ"]` — our rouge script strips punctuation with regex that assumes consistent token boundaries. quant tokenizer emits subword markers that change counts.

jess: plan of action:
1) repro + minimal failing examples (owner: omar)
2) add guard in metrics runner to avoid crashing CI (owner: kai)
3) inspect tokenizer mapping and quant table diffs (owner: eva)
4) add a dashboard metric for per-model NaN-rate and rouge-tokenization-diff rate

can everyone ack owners?

omar: ack — will have repro + initial diff by EOD.

kai: ack — will open a small PR with guard + unit test.

eva: ack — will dump tokenizer vocab diffs and start a PR for deterministic post-tokenize normalization.

jess: thx all :thumbsup: one more ask — do NOT mute the metric regression alerts globally. if we need to quiet noise, open a ticket and scope it to the specific model.

ci-bot: created ticket RW-987: "quant onboarding: bertscore/rouge NaN & tokenization mismatch" assigned to omar — https://tickets.internal/RW-987

jess: adding note for ops: please add a NaN-rate gauge to the metrics exporter (per-model, per-metric). omar, can you add to the prometheus exporter when you push the repro?

omar: will add prometheus gauge + grafana panel in the same PR.

(brief)
